items.a: Yes. Upload your brochures or connect a sheet of listings.

problems.title: Where property leads go cold, and what your agent does about it.
problems.intro: Buyers compare several projects at once. The team that answers first and books the visit usually wins.

items.pain: Leads wait hours for a reply.
items.scene: An ad brings 80 enquiries on Sunday. Your team answers on Monday.
items.fix: Your agent answers configurations, prices and amenities straight away from your brochures and listings.
items.reply: Yes, a few 3BHK homes are left in Tower C.

items.pain: Your team calls people who were never serious.
items.scene: Hours on the phone with buyers outside your budget.
items.fix: Your agent asks budget, size and timeline first, and saves them to your CRM.
items.ask: What is the price per square foot?
items.reply: It starts at ₹7,800. What budget are you working with?

items.pain: Site visits take days to fix.
items.scene: Messages back and forth to agree a weekend slot.
items.fix: Your agent books visits straight into your sales team’s calendar.
items.reply: Saturday at 11 is free. Shall I book it?

items.pain: Hot buyers get the same treatment as everyone.
items.scene: A ready buyer waits in the same queue as a casual browser.
items.fix: Serious buyers go straight to your team with the full conversation.
items.ask: I want to book a unit today.
items.reply: Great. I am connecting you with our sales team now.
